Thyroid Imbalance? Signs, Causes, Natural Fixes | Dr. Hansaji
The thyroid is a small gland, but its hormones influence metabolism, heart rate, digestion, body temperature, energy and many other functions. Thyroid imbalance can take different forms, and hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism require different approaches to food, exercise and lifestyle.
